title: Cornwall’s Holywell Cave collapses after an overnight cliff fall
summary_full: Holywell cave, a significant landmark in Cornwall, collapsed after a cliff fall, rendering it inaccessible. This incident occurred overnight and resulted in the area being cordoned off by lifeguards for safety. Local residents and visitors expressed shock at the loss of this iconic site, which featured in the drama Poldark. Many tourists had frequented the cave due to its unique geological formations and connections to popular films.
